_comment: THIS FILE IS NOT LOADED FROM HERE, AND THAT IS THE POINT.
A plugin's hooks live at <plugin>/hooks/hooks.json. This plugin is the
repository, so a hooks.json committed at the repository root would fire in
every session of every user who installs tla-spec-dev -- a SessionStart
shell script nobody asked for, and (exit 2 being blocking) a way for an
eval-only fixture script to refuse somebody's ordinary session.
So it is staged instead: evals/run.sh copies this file to
<view>/hooks/hooks.json inside the throwaway view it builds, where it is
loaded for the eval run and for nothing else. The shipped plugin gains no
hooks and no new way to refuse (GOAL-no-new-gates).
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is the view, so the two scripts resolve inside it.
Verified on 2.1.275: a probe case whose SessionStart hook wrote a file and
whose Stop hook wrote another scored 1.00 with both verdict paths present,
with no Bash grant and no scratch HOME.
SessionEnd carries the same verifier as Stop deliberately: measured in the
skill-manager wide lane (2026-09-14, 2.1.270), a run that ends
error_max_turns fires SessionEnd and NOT Stop, and a round registered only
on Stop lost every verdict on 12 capped runs and scored them red. Both
derive the same verdicts, so the second write is harmless.

SI-21/EA-DF-13: skt's SHIPPED SessionStart hook is staged alongside place.sh, second so it runs after the fixture exists. Before this, run.sh overwrote hooks.json and the shipped orientation never fired, so every case graded an agent working WITHOUT the report the product injects -- and `skt status` ends with the line `next  skt check`, which is the exact command w-sm-verify-is-not-currency scored an agent for not finding. The suite was measuring a counterfactual and charging the substrate for it. The hook never exits non-zero by contract, so it cannot refuse a run (GOAL-no-new-gates), and staging it makes this suite evidence about the shipped hooks for the first time.
